_comment: The clip desktop-audio wire (frontend/src-tauri/src/clip_audio_wire.rs audio_frame -> frontend/src/api/clips/audioWire.ts readAudioFrame), message by message: the fields and the exact bytes. clip_audio_wire.rs's tests BUILD each message from its fields and must produce these bytes; src/tests/audioWire.test.ts READS these bytes and must get these fields, so neither side can change the layout without the other. The hex was produced by an independent encoder (Python struct '<BBQIHII', then '<II' per packet, then planar '<f'), not by either implementation. Header: u8 version, u8 flags (bit 0 = silent), u64 generation, u32 sample rate, u16 channels, u32 frames, u32 packets; then per packet u32 frames and u32 age in us (how long before the message was sent that packet was read); then channels x frames f32, planar, absent when silent. All little-endian.

cases.name: stereo: the header, the packet table, then all of channel 0's samples, then all of channel 1's
a silent run carries no samples, however many frames its packets count (5.1 at 44.1 kHz)
7.1, a generation past 32 bits and a packet a timeout sent a second after it was read
